title: Message-ID validation is strict and at a single entry point
description: core/src/validation.rs: validate_message_id() enforces RFC 5322 §3.6.4 format (angle brackets required, exactly one @, no whitespace, non-empty local and domain parts). It is the single entry point for untrusted wire Message-IDs; no other code constructs or accepts an unvalidated Message-ID. A contributor might loosen the check to accept 'common' malformed IDs from legacy software — resist this. The strict check is the first defense against injection into msgid_map and group log keys.
